conviction_note: Public USDA prices plus the company's own July quarter-to-date data put Q1 revenue around $545-560m against a $587m consensus, a likely miss. But this name bought +0.7% on a far larger miss in July, it arrives -14% over 20 days at a 52-week low with 11.8% of float short, and the sell side has already cut EPS to -$0.88 against a stale -$0.47 headline. So the reaction read cancels the fundamental read and the number sits near zero: -0.1, the sum of -0.6 and +0.5.
bar: Revenue $586-588m from two agreeing sources: $587.8m (https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/calmaine-earnings-on-deck-amid-weak-egg-pricing-cost-pressure-93CH-4922891, 2026-09-29) and $586.3m (https://www.quiverquant.com/news/CAL-MAINE+FOODS+Q1+2027+Earnings+Preview:+Recent+$CALM+Insider+Trading,+Hedge+Fund+Activity,+and+More). The EPS bar is NOT resolvable: -$0.47 (Investing/Zacks-style), -$0.72 (Quiver) and BMO's -$0.88 dated 2026-09-24 (https://www.investing.com/news/analyst-ratings/bmo-cuts-calmaine-foods-stock-price-target-on-higher-costs-93CH-4915695). The company gives no guidance. Revenue is the bar sized against; EPS findings are capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest is 4.96m shares, 11.81% of float (10.58% of shares outstanding), 5.36 days to cover, up from 4.77m the prior month. Source: stockanalysis.com statistics page read 2026-09-29, settlement date not shown (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/calm/statistics/). That is elevated but short of the 18-23% squeeze cases. Skew is -0.59 vol points (balanced, a slight call premium). Put/call OI is 0.73. The event-implied move is 7.07%, against a median historical reaction of 1.61%. The stock is 0.5% above its 52-week low: -14.2% over 20 days and -7.4% over 5 days. The market is visibly braced for a bad quarter.

findings.finding: Q1 FY27 (Jun-Aug 2026) conventional egg prices averaged roughly flat to down against Q4's $1.08 Urner Barry average. The company's own figure is $0.72 for the first five weeks; USDA Midwest warehouse Large ran $0.50 in early June, rose to $1.31 at end-July and fell to $0.69 by Aug 21. That puts Q1 revenue near $545-560m, below the $587m consensus, which implies +6% QoQ over Q4's $552.6m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q4 FY26 on 2026-07-22 missed badly on revenue ($552.6m) and EPS (-$0.76 vs +$0.11) and the stock closed +0.7% (baseline). Q4 FY25 on 2025-07-22 was a large beat and moved +13.8%. Misses on this line have not been sold.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus revenue still implies Q1 above Q4 while the price series says flat or lower. If the market had marked it, revenue estimates would sit at or below $553m rather than $587m, and the 6% cut over 60 days would have gone further. The price partly reflects it anyway: -14% in 20 days and target cuts in September.
findings.independence: USDA AMS weekly egg reports via IndexBox, a different source from the company release: early June Midwest $0.50 (https://www.indexbox.io/blog/usda-egg-market-report-wholesale-prices-decline-in-early-june-2026/), end-July $1.31 (https://www.indexbox.io/blog/egg-market-report-july-31-2026-mixed-prices-strong-cage-free-retail-features/), Aug 14 $1.02 (https://www.indexbox.io/blog/usda-egg-market-report-wholesale-prices-decline-in-mid-august-2026/), Aug 21 $0.69 (https://www.indexbox.io/blog/usda-egg-market-report-wholesale-prices-decline-demand-indicator-rises/). The Q4 $1.08 UB average comes from the Q4 transcript (https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-calmaine-foods-q4-2026-miss-hits-shares-as-egg-prices-slump-93CH-4806250). This is still a proxy-to-company transmission: specialty (43% of shell-egg sales, mostly grain-based or fixed pricing) and prepared foods (~$60m, plus Van's) dampen it.

findings.finding: The effective EPS bar is well below the headline consensus. BMO cut its Q1 estimate to -$0.88 from -$0.55 on 2026-09-24 and Stephens cut on 2026-09-22, while the aggregated consensus still reads -$0.47. A print of roughly -$0.60 to -$0.85 would headline as a miss but meet the bar the sell side and the tape are actually holding.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: July 2026: a headline EPS miss of 87 cents closed +0.7%. 5 of the last 7 reactions were up.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The stock fell 7.4% in the five sessions around these cuts. What is unpriced is only the gap between the stale -$0.47 headline and the real bar. If the market were not braced, the stock would not sit at a 52-week low with short interest rising into the print.
findings.independence: Stephens target cut 2026-09-22 (https://www.investing.com/news/analyst-ratings/stephens-cuts-calmaine-foods-stock-price-target-on-weak-demand-93CH-4910949). Quiver's -$0.72 consensus sits between the two. Shares the 'weak Q1' premise with finding 1, but lands on the reaction rather than the number, so the two can both be true.

outside_window.finding: HPAI returned early to Minnesota commercial flocks from 2026-09-01 (seven commercial flocks, more than 260k birds, mostly not layers). A spread into layers would lift Q2 FY27 pricing, but Q2 prices resolve over Sep-Nov, not in the exit window. Q2-to-date wholesale prices are weak: Midwest $0.65, national loose $0.39 on the 2026-09-28 report.

searched_and_found_nothing: 8-K 2026-09-02 (items 1.01/2.03): a routine $250m unsecured revolver renewal with BMO as agent, zero drawn, $924m cash. Financing question answered: no distress and no ramp to fund, so a zero. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/16160/000156276226000102/calm-20260831_8K.htm
8-K 2026-06-30 DOJ cage-free cooperative settlement: $1.5m plus a 30m-egg donation, immaterial and public. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/16160/000156276226000076/exhibit991.htm

HPAI in layers in June-September 2026: the dvm360 '10 million birds' story is dated 2026-03-27, not current. https://www.dvm360.com/view/h5n1-bird-flu-is-advancing-east-with-roughly-10-million-birds-affected-in-the-past-month
The Van's and Eggland's Best Northeast territory deals are already in the July 10-K and the wire; about +10% to prepared-foods sales, small against the total.

Q2-to-date September pricing is weak and fully public (USDA 2026-09-28, https://www.indexbox.io/blog/usda-egg-market-data-september-28-2026-wholesale-prices-inventories-and-demand/), and the September target cuts already cite it, so it is not unpriced.
Insider activity: $0.3m of insider buys over 12 months and no Form 4 cluster found in the recent EDGAR list.
Buybacks: shares fell 0.87% QoQ per stockanalysis and $320.7m of authorisation remains. Q1 repurchases will be disclosed, but no evidence was found of an acceleration that is not already assumed.
baseline_tension: Both findings roughly agree with the price: a negative fundamental read on a stock already -14% over 20 days with balanced skew and rising shorts is mostly priced. The reaction-history offset brings the net to about zero, so the price already has nearly all of this.
lessons_applied: Lesson 5 (a narrow proxy is a hypothesis until the company says it) and lesson 1 (a July miss bought +0.7%): revenue-miss finding cut from -1.2 to -0.6. Only the first five weeks are company-stated; the rest of the quarter is reconstructed from USDA weekly prices.
Lesson 7 (look at crowded shorts before a negative): 11.8% of float short with 5.4 days to cover and rising supports shrinking the negative. Recorded in positioning_check.

Lesson 6 (bar verification): revenue bar confirmed from two agreeing sources; the EPS bar disagrees three ways (-0.47/-0.72/-0.88), so the EPS-bar positioning finding was cut from +1.0 to +0.5. It rests on wire copy (the BMO note) and is mostly priced.

Lesson 9 (size a segment net of the rest): the conventional-price finding is sized net of specialty (43% of shell sales, on grain-based or fixed pricing) and prepared foods, which dampen it. Revenue estimate revised to about -5% versus the bar, from -4%.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the Sept 2 revolver renewal was checked. It is undrawn with $924m cash, so no finding.
